title: Late Night Ribs Trump for Leaving Staff Behind on Air Force One
summary: Anthony Anderson, the guest host of “Jimmy Kimmel Live,” called the ruse in which President Trump exited the plane in a catering container “Operation Pig in a Blanket.”
